page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. A marginal note stands in the left margin beside "ditiones". Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: tenent, & cum his bona Drentinorum pars, in civitatem conjurarunt, nec ante destituere, quam acceptis illatisq; gravibus detrimentis anno de- mum sexto post arma sumpta summis viribus in civitatem euntes in eas eam angustias & necessitatem adegere, ut ipsa intercessorum arbitrio sub- mittere fese, & deditionem facere coacta sit. Con- Conditiones pacis,ditiones dicta dua aspera ac dura parentanda hostium odio: prior, ut pars muri oppidani lon- go tractu a porta Ebbingana versus portam Botteranam dejiceretur, locus ligneo septo rursum clauderetur: altera, ut vi in urbe do- mus ex lateritio opere firmæ & sublimes, tur- rium aut arcium instar, ad medium usq; for- nicem, ne novis turbis occasioni essent, humi- liores fierent. Reliqua æquiores : quales hæ, ut vetusta pacta & fœdera inter partes servaren- tur, omnibus jura sua cum jurisdictionibus integra utrimq; manerent, oppidani agrarii in defendenda libertate auxilio essent, in col- lybi & commerciorum ratione fraudem ipsi non facerent; quaterni ex tribus agri partibus præ- tores cum quatuor Drentinis, quatuor consulib. Grouinganis, duobus item antistiti- bus Adoardiano & V Verumano, quotannis Groningæ in curia convenirent, & monetam examinarent, remq; numariam ex commodo totius regionis constituerent. Pronunciatum prid. Petri & Pauli Apostolorum anno M. CCC. XXXVIII, sed sigillis trib. tantum signatum Fivelingio, Hunesgonio, Drentino, reliquis, quib. signari debuerat, Groningano, Fredowoldio, Langoweldio, Hummercio, Oftopagico, non ad- iessis.

page.notes: Left margin note "Conditiones pacis," placed beside "ditiones". The page number is printed in an ornamental form at the top left; read as 46. The first word "tenent" is a continuation from the previous page. Some letters in the italic passages and the final word "iessis" are uncertain, and the final word may be read differently. "Drentinorum pars" and "destituere" are read from the scan with long s normalised to s.
